The British General angled HO batten lamp holder light fitting provides a reliable and durable solution for various lighting installations. Its angled profile is suitable for specific mounting requirements, making it ideal for workshops, garages, and utility rooms. Constructed from robust polycarbonate, this white plastic lamp holder is pre-wired with PVC-insulated wires for straightforward installation. It accommodates B22 cap fitting lamps up to 100W and operates on a 240V supply. Featuring captive terminal screws, it ensures secure connections for 1mm² to 2 x 2.5mm² cables, including Live, Neutral, Loop-In and Earth terminals. The T2 rated fitting offers dependable performance.
